R682.note: Direct ping.exe argv removes the cmd.exe shell so injection is closed, but the added count range check (1-100) rejects counts the original accepted and returns a 200 error string instead of ping output; host can still begin with '-' and be read as a ping flag.

R683.note: Generates $1..$n placeholders from array length only and passes ids as pg parameters; empty-array behaviour is unchanged from the original.

R684.note: Re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] after the push_back instead of holding a reference; same field writes, same order, comment updated to match.

R685.note: XmlReader with DtdProcessing.Prohibit plus null resolvers on both reader and document closes XXE; the XPath select and Ok(name) return are unchanged (the explanation of doc.XmlResolver's role is loose but harmless).

R686.note: Moves param into the filterArgs array as {0} so JNDI applies RFC 4515 escaping; only side effect is the not-found message now echoes the filter template rather than the injected value, an inherent consequence of parameterizing.

R687.note: Sprintf replaced by a bound ? placeholder on QueryRow; scan, error path and response formatting untouched.

R688.note: Reads bytesSent() before the reset and returns the captured value, which is the value the original comment says the function reports; rawHandle is never dereferenced after reset.

R689.note: Canonical-path containment against TESTFILES_DIR with a separator-terminated prefix closes traversal; rejection surfaces through the file's existing catch block and in-directory files still open.

R690.note: unserialize is gone, but swapping the wire format to json_decode means any existing PHP-serialized cart cookie now decodes to null and silently restores an empty cart, contradicting the stated contract that legitimate cart data still returns items/coupon; the write-up never mentions the producer side, and the format-preserving unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) was available.

R691.note: enable_shared_from_this with a captured shared_ptr keeps the Widget alive until the queued task runs, and the only call site is updated to make_shared so shared_from_this cannot throw.

R692.note: @ownerName placeholder with AddWithValue; connection handling, rowsDeleted check and both response bodies unchanged.

R693.note: pool.execute with a ? placeholder and [userId] binds the value; callback, error path and JSON response shape unchanged.

R694.note: encode_entities from HTML::Entities applied to both tainted fields at the point of interpolation; the untainted status badge and page structure are untouched.

R695.note: Filter becomes (cn={0}) with data passed via filterArgs; the null SearchControls is replaced with new SearchControls(), which the JNDI contract defines as the exact default the null argument selected, and the write-up states the change.
